title: A calmer experience for more people
intro: We are building Ancestral Path so visitors can read, navigate, and contact us in ways that work for them.

sections.heading: Keyboard access
sections.body: Interactive controls use visible focus styles and native buttons, forms, and disclosures.

sections.heading: Readable design
sections.body: The site uses responsive type, strong contrast, and reduced-motion support.

sections.heading: Need help?
sections.body: If a page or interaction is difficult to use, contact us and tell us what would help.
